author: Meibbo
name: vaultman
description: Files, content and frontmatter explorer like Bases with scoped queued changes list.

scripts.build: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node scripts/sync-test-build.mjs
scripts.version: node scripts/version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.verify: pnpm run lint && pnpm run check && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run stylelint && pnpm run build:plugin && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:scorecard
scripts.test:integrity: pnpm run build && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:all: pnpm run test:integrity && pnpm run test:e2e

//security:audit: Audit is scoped to production (shipped) dependencies. The only high-severity advisories are in devDependency test tooling (vite via vitest/obsidian-integration-testing, undici via @wdio); none are in the shipped plugin bundle. vite is frozen at 8.0.12 by a patch-package patch in the e2e harness, so it cannot be bumped without recreating that patch. pnpm.auditConfig.ignoreGhsas proved environment-inconsistent (honored locally, not on CI), so we gate on --prod instead.
